_about: Fast chat (FastChat.cs, 2026-10-08, David: answer chat in seconds, not ~60 s). A conversational nearby-chat line or IM that the instant replies (_instant-replies.json) did not take is answered by the client itself via the xAI chat completions API: persona below (stable, cached) + current state + the last history_lines lines of THAT conversation (nearby chat and each IM session are kept apart). The reply is claimed like 'say --re' / 'im --re' so the chat routine never answers it again. Requests to DO something: the model only writes a short ack (David only), the line goes on to the chat routine with fast_ack set, and the routine does the action. API error, timeout (timeout_s) or an empty reply: the line goes to the routine as before. Read fresh on every line; enabled=false turns it off. Key: env XAI_API_KEY, else the box secret store card.XAI_API_KEY (never logged). Token usage per call: fastchat-usage.jsonl next to the client log ('fastchat status').
